summary: Flat aluminum pattern plate with a stadium (round-end) outline, 56mm long, 32mm wide and 2.5mm thick. It has two large 14mm through holes along the centerline, surrounded by a pattern of smaller through holes.

mountingSurfaces.description: Top flat face for mounting hubs, bearings or brackets against the plate.
Bottom flat face, mounts flush against rails or channel.

notes: Bounds come from the stated dimensions (56 x 32 x 2.5mm), which are marked unverified. The two 14mm holes are placed at x = ±12mm, assuming each is concentric with a semicircular end of radius 16mm (56/2 - 16 = 12). This matches the 24mm center spacing in the description. The images show about 14 smaller through holes and some slotted ones, arranged in a 16mm goBILDA pattern. Their diameter and exact positions are not stated, so they are left out of the holes list instead of guessed. Product Insight #2 shows the plate fastened across two flush goRAIL pieces with 12mm M4 screws, with T-slots 24mm apart.
